text:
sara: FYI: multiple customers seeing 503s on /v1/generate since ~08:12 UTC in hosted-us-east. Error spike ~22%. Symptoms: runner SIGSEGV and container restarts. Paging eng-sre.

infra-bot: Alert from hosted-us-east: infer-runner pods restarted (restart_count >= 3) on pool infer-queue-1. OOM events present.

tim_oncall: I'm looking. Which customers and sample payloads?

sara: Affected: AcmeCorp and a few smaller tenants. Example: long-context chat + authenticated tool_call (function: summarize) -> context ~55–65k tokens, qps ~100–140 sustained. Attached short log:
```
[runner] 2026-03-17T08:12:43Z ERROR: runtime: signal SIGSEGV (address=0x7f...)
[runner] cuda: device-side assert triggered; kernel launch failed
[runner] pid=12345 uid=0: exit status 139
```

lucas: That stacktrace + device assert smells like an assert in a fused kernel after a quantized path or an out-of-bounds index from KV prefetch. Any recent model/runtime changes in us-east?

sara: We started a v2.4.0 rollout ~06:30 UTC (fused-attn + aggressive kv-prefetch). Rollout at ~50% earlier today.

maria: Repro hypothesis: long-prefix triggers full-KV prefetch which oversubscribes GPU mem on some kernels (quant + fp16 mixed ops) -> device-side assert then segfault. I can reproduce locally with a script that sends a 60k token prompt and tool_call.

tim_oncall: Temp mitigations we can apply now: 1) pause v2.4.0 rollout in us-east and revert to v2.3.1, 2) route high-context requests to CPU fallback variant, 3) reduce max_batch_tokens and disable aggressive prefetch on prod. Can we flip those quickly?

infra-bot: Rollback command received: deployment infer-runtime v2.3.1 -> set weight=100% in us-east. Started rolling updates to 24 pods. ETA ~4m.

sara: Doing customer comms. Updating support tickets with temporary workaround and asking customers to reduce context length where possible.

lucas: I'll build a debug instrumented v2.4.0 with extra kernel checks and ASAN logs. Also filing ENG-RUNTIME-789. Please capture nvcrashdump and full dmesg for the restarted hosts.

maria: Uploading repro script and sample requests to the incident channel. Repro steps: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -X POST /v1/generate -d @large_toolcall.json (payload will be in the incident artifacts).

incident-bot: P0 incident created: INC-2026-003. Bridge scheduled: 08:45 UTC. Pager oncall: tim_oncall. Teams assigned: eng-runtime, eng-sre, eng-ml.

infra-bot: Post-rollback metrics: 5xx rate dropping. current 5xx=0.9% (was 22%). Pod restarts decreasing.

tim_oncall: Good. Next steps: eng-runtime to root cause + fix in v2.4.0, eng-ml to validate kv-prefetch limits across quantized kernels, eng-sre to add alert for restart ramp and docker restart surge, postmortem within 72h.

sara: Customer update sent: temporary rollback + CPU fallback applied; we will follow up with timeline for permanent fix.

lucas: For root cause, we need reproducer run across all quantized kernels and a guard to avoid prefetch when estimated memory > allowed threshold. Will prioritize a patch and test.

maria: Collected nvcrashdump from 3 pods, heap profiles, and the repro logs. Sharing links in incident artifacts.

incident-bot: Follow-up task created: TASK-2026-112 "Add predeploy test: long-context tool_call across quantized kernels" assigned to eng-runtime.

tim_oncall: Keep me posted on repro confirmation. Once stable for 1h we can close the active paging but keep incident open until postmortem.

sara: Acknowledged. Closing thread when postmortem is published and customers are confirmed. :thumbsup:
